title.zh: 授权拨款25000比索援助伊洛伊洛省New Lucena市镇购置市政厅与公共广场占用场地，包括该场地的改良
title.en: An Act Authorizing the Appropriation of Twenty-Five Thousand Pesos as Aid to the Municipality of New Lucena, Province of Iloilo, for the Purchase of the Site Occupied by the Town Hall and Public Plaza, Including the Improvement of Said Site
title.orig: An Act Authorizing the Appropriation of Twenty-Five Thousand Pesos as Aid to the Municipality of New Lucena, Province of Iloilo, for the Purchase of the Site Occupied by the Town Hall and Public Plaza, Including the Improvement of Said Site

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1967/ra_5007_1967.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sum of twenty-five thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, as aid to the Municipality of New Lucena, Province of Iloilo, for the purchase of the site occupied by the town hall and public plaza, including the improvement of said site.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 17, 1967.
